extensionDescription.message: Watch Twitch fullscreen without missing chat. Adds a customizable danmaku overlay with Twitch, 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes.

settingsFeedbackQuestion.message: How is Danmaku working for you?

settingsFeedbackPrompt.message: Rate the extension or send feedback.

settingsFontsReading.message: Reading fonts installed on this device…

settingsAdaptBusyChatTitle.message: Adapts message rate and speed when chat gets busy

settingsFavoriteHint.message: Choose the people and roles you want to prioritize when chat gets busy.

settingsBusyEffectsHint.message: All chatters automatically switches to favorites when chat gets busy.

settingsReplyContextTitle.message: Include the replied-to user and a short quote

settingsPauseVodTitle.message: Freeze the overlay when a VOD is paused

settingsHelpHint.message: Get help, report a problem, or share an honest rating.

translationHelpBody.message: This translation is new. If anything sounds incorrect or unnatural, please tell us.

regionDropsTitle.message: Messages dropped in the last 10 seconds. Open settings for details.

welcomeTitle.message: Keep watching. Keep up with chat.

welcomeIntro.message: Twitch chat now appears directly over the video as smooth, readable messages—including in theater and fullscreen modes.

welcomeRefreshBody.message: This Twitch tab was already open when Danmaku started. Refresh it once to activate the overlay.

welcomeStepOneBody.message: The overlay starts automatically when chat is available.

welcomeStepTwoBody.message: Click the Danmaku player button whenever you want to hide or restore the overlay.

welcomeStepThreeBody.message: Open settings to adjust placement, rows, text size, motion, and favorites.

welcomeChromeBody.message: On a Twitch tab, click the Danmaku extension icon. If it is hidden, open Extensions and pin it first.

welcomePlayerBody.message: Right-click the Danmaku button in the player controls. A normal click toggles the overlay.

welcomePrivacy.message: No account, ads, analytics, or remote data collection. Your settings stay on this device.

welcomeRefreshFailed.message: Could not refresh that tab. Return to Twitch and refresh it manually.

welcomeOpenFailed.message: Could not open Twitch. Visit twitch.tv to get started.

animScrollDescription.message: Classic right-to-left scroll across the player.

animDriftDescription.message: Right-to-left scroll with a slow vertical wobble.

animPopFadeDescription.message: Messages pop in at a random spot, hold briefly, then fade out.

animSlideUpDescription.message: Messages slide in from below, hold, then drift up and fade.

effectStyleOffDescription.message: Use the chatter's original Twitch color without animation.

effectStyleFixedDescription.message: Use the same effect and color pairing for every selected chatter.

effectStylePersonalizedDescription.message: Give each chatter a consistent look based on their username.

effectFlowDescription.message: A smooth color sweep across the username.

effectEmberDescription.message: Rising sparks and organic texture inside the username.

effectGlitchDescription.message: Brief displaced color slices over the original username.

paletteSameHueDescription.message: Two lightness levels of the chatter's original hue.

paletteNearbyHuesDescription.message: The original color plus a nearby hue for gentle contrast.

paletteOppositeHuesDescription.message: The original color plus a softened opposite hue for bold contrast.

statusFontsUnavailable.message: Installed fonts are unavailable; using Default.

statusFontsPrivate.message: Fonts are read from this device and never uploaded.

statusOpenStreamDynamic.message: Open a stream to test dynamic mode

statusOpenStreamHighlights.message: Open a stream to test highlights

statusEnableFavoriteFirst.message: Enable a badge role or add a username first

diagnosticsNoDrops.message: No messages dropped in the last 10 s.

diagnosticsDroppedOne.message: 1 message dropped in the last 10 s:

diagnosticsDroppedMany.message: $COUNT$ messages dropped in the last 10 s:

diagnosticsRateLimitHint.message: Chat is arriving faster than the renderer drains it. Raise ‘Messages per second’.

diagnosticsLaneSaturationHint.message: All rows are busy. Add rows or lower ‘Travel time’.

diagnosticsActiveCapHint.message: Internal ceiling reached; usually only on wide players with long durations.

releaseNoteOnboarding.message: A guided welcome page and one-click recovery for Twitch tabs that need a refresh.

releaseNoteFeedback.message: Always-available help, feedback, and rating links in settings.

releaseNoteLocalization.message: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese interface support.
